## Plan: Character Creator App – Final, Complete Architecture

The character creator app enables users to design unique 32×32 pixel characters by selecting pre-made body parts with a live-updating preview. Characters are **final upon creation** (no editing). Users start with **4 free character slots** and can purchase additional slots via external shop. Body parts are **free or purchasable/unlockable** through ProgressionManager. Characters have distinct gold (in their `stats`), separate from user currency in `UserManager.user_data.currency`. Each character has a globally-unique name, optional category tag, game-state statistics (1–99 bounded), personal inventory (10 slots), and persist as global items. Deleted characters enter a graveyard. Characters export to JSON and are queryable by games for cross-app RPG progression.

### Steps

1. **Create ProgressionManager singleton (Layer 5.5)** — Build minimal stub to track `unlocked_body_parts: Array[String]` and `completed_milestones: Dictionary`. Expose methods: `is_body_part_unlocked(part_id) -> bool`, `unlock_body_part(part_id)`. Emit signals: `body_part_unlocked(part_id)`, `milestone_completed(milestone_id)`. Persist to global save. Leave achievement hooks as TODO comments for future expansion.
2. **Extend InventoryManager for character containers** — Add `containers: Dictionary` mapping character IDs to inventory slot arrays. Add methods: `get_container_slots(character_id) -> Array`, `add_to_container(character_id, item_id, amount, validate_bound) -> bool`, `remove_from_container(character_id, item_id, amount) -> bool`, `swap_container_slots(char_id, from_idx, to_idx, validate_bound) -> bool`. Persist containers in global save under `character_containers`. Emit signal `container_inventory_changed(character_id)`.
3. **Create character data schema and CharacterManager singleton** — Design character metadata: `{ id, name, category, body_parts: {head, eyes, mouth, hair, arms, hands, legs, feet}, stats: {gold, agility, strength, intelligence, constitution, luck}, inventory_capacity: 10, created_date, deleted: false }`. Build CharacterManager (Layer 5 singleton) to handle: creation with slot checking, globally-unique name validation, stat management (bounded 1–99), category tagging, character count tracking, stat modification with bounds validation, graveyard soft-delete, and persistence. Emit signals: `character_created(char_id)`, `character_deleted(char_id)`, `character_stats_changed(char_id)`, `character_category_changed(char_id)`, `slot_count_changed(count)`.
4. **Create character slot management system** — Track `user_data.character_slots_owned: int` (default: 4) in UserManager global save. Add CharacterManager method `can_create_character() -> bool` (active count < owned slots). Add `get_active_character_count() -> int` (non-deleted characters). Add `purchase_character_slot()` method that emits EventBus event `"shop_open"` with payload `{ item: "character_slot", cost: 100 }`, allowing external shop app to handle purchase and increment slot count.
5. **Organize body part assets with unlock metadata** — Create folder structure: `data/items/assets/character_parts/<part_type>/` (e.g., `head/`, `eyes/`, `mouth/`, `hair/`, `arms/`, `hands/`, `legs/`, `feet/`). For each part type, create `manifest.json`: `{ parts: [{ id: "head_001", name: "Classic Head", cost: 0, texture_path: "head_001.png" }, ...] }`. Place sprite files (`.png`, 32×32 canonical size) in same folder. Mark `cost: 0` for free parts; all others unlocked via ProgressionManager.
6. **Create body part registry system** — Build BodyPartRegistry (autoload or helper class) to: scan `data/items/assets/character_parts/*/manifest.json` at startup (lazy-load on Character Creator initialization), cache all available parts by type, expose methods `get_parts_by_type(type) -> Array[Dictionary]`, `get_part(part_id) -> Dictionary`, `is_part_unlocked(part_id, user_data) -> bool`. Cache texture references (keyed by part_id) to avoid re-reads. Textures remain 32×32 canonical; UI preview scaling handled separately.
7. **Create character graveyard system** — In CharacterManager, add graveyard storage: `graveyard: Array[Dictionary]` with schema `{ name, deletion_date, highest_stat, final_gold }`. On soft-delete, extract epitaph data and append to graveyard. Store graveyard in `user://character_graveyard.json`. Add methods: `view_graveyard() -> Array[Dictionary]`, `purge_graveyard_entry(graveyard_index)`, `clear_graveyard()`. All graveyard ops trigger persist. (Graveyard export/import deferred as future feature.)
8. **Build character templates system** — Create `apps/character_creator/templates/` folder with JSON files (e.g., `warrior.json`, `mage.json`, `rogue.json`). Schema: `{ name, body_parts: {head, eyes, ...}, suggested_stats: {gold, agility, ...} }`. Build template loader in Character Creator app. Expose templates as quick-start buttons in creation UI; clicking pre-populates body part selections and stat suggestions (user can override).
9. **Create Character Creator app scaffold** — Set up `apps/character_creator/` with:
   * `manifest.json` (permissions: `['inventory', 'character_stats', 'body_parts']`)
   * `character_creator.tscn` (root Control scene with tabs: Creation, Gallery, Graveyard)
   * `character_creator.gd` (extends AppBase, implements lifecycle and state management)
10. **Build body part selection UI with unlock indicators** — In Creation tab, create vertical section for each part type (Head, Eyes, Mouth, Hair, Arms, Hands, Legs, Feet). Each section: ScrollContainer with HBoxContainer showing thumbnails (48×48 scaled from 32×32 canonical) of available parts. For each part: show texture thumbnail, part name, cost badge (if > 0). Locked parts: gray overlay + lock icon + "Unlock for [cost]" button. Clicking a part updates live preview immediately. Clicking "Unlock" button emits EventBus `"shop_open"` with `{ item: part_id, cost: cost }`. Texture scaling configurable via settings (deferred feature).
11. **Implement in-engine character rendering** — Create `CharacterRenderer` (static helper or scene component) with method `render_character(body_parts_dict) -> Image`. Layer textures onto 32×32 viewport in order: legs → torso → arms → head → hair. Cache final composite in memory (keyed by body_parts_dict hash). Expose as public API so games can render characters. Use `CanvasItem.draw_set_transform()` or `Sprite2D` nodes to composite.
12. **Build character name input with validation dialog** — In Creation tab, add text input field for character name. On "Create Character" button click, validate: name not empty, length 1–32 characters, **not already used globally** (query CharacterManager.get_all_characters()), no special chars (alphanumeric + underscore/space only). Show error dialog if invalid. Prevent save until valid.
13. **Implement character category/tagging system** — Add optional text input or OptionButton for character category. User can type freeform or select from list of past categories (cached in global save). Default empty string. Store in character metadata `category: String`. Display category as badge/label in gallery cards.
14. **Build character stat configuration panel** — Show 6 editable SpinBox fields for starting stats: Gold, Agility, Strength, Intelligence, Constitution, Luck. Bounds: 1–99 per field, with validation. Allow manual entry. Optionally show "Apply Template Preset" buttons (Warrior, Mage, Rogue) that pre-fill stat suggestions. Confirm button locks stats before character creation.
15. **Add stat modification validation** — In CharacterManager, implement `modify_stat(char_id: String, stat_name: String, delta: int) -> bool`. Enforce: new value clamped to [1, 99], reject if character not found. Emit `character_stats_changed(char_id)` signal. Log changes. Return success/failure. Stat caps remain fixed for MVP (future progression module can raise caps per level if needed).
16. **Implement character save to inventory** — When user clicks "Create Character" button in Creation tab: validate slot availability (`CharacterManager.can_create_character()`). If not available, show dialog "No character slots available. Purchase more?" with button linking to shop via EventBus `"shop_open"` event (`{ item: "character_slot", cost: 100 }`). If available, call `CharacterManager.create_character(name, category, body_parts_dict, initial_stats)`, which: generates unique char ID (timestamp + deterministic hash of body_parts), creates item manifest in `data/items/<char_id>/item_manifest.json`, registers in ItemRegistry, adds to global inventory with `InventoryManager.add_item(char_id, 1)`, initializes empty character container in InventoryManager, persists character metadata to `user://characters/<char_id>.json`. Clear UI and show success message.
17. **Build character gallery view** — In Gallery tab, display all active characters in categorized grid. Top: slot counter badge ("3 of 4 slots used"). Tabs by category (dynamically generated from saved characters) + "All" tab. Each category tab shows GridContainer (4 columns) with character cards. Card layout: composite 32×32 preview (top), name label (bottom), category badge, stat summary tooltip (hover to view). Include "New Character" button (scrolls to Creation tab). If at slot capacity, show "Purchase Slot" button instead.
18. **Add character deletion and graveyard UI** — Add delete button on each character card (confirmation dialog: "Delete [Name]? This is permanent."). Soft-delete moves character to graveyard and removes from active inventory. In Graveyard tab, display graveyard entries as minimal epitaph cards: name, deletion date, highest stat with value, final gold amount. Include "Purge Entry" button per epitaph (confirmation). Include "Clear Graveyard" button (clears all, confirmation).
19. **Connect character-to-character inventory UI** — When user selects a character in Gallery, display below/aside: mini-inventory panel heading "Inventory" with 10 slots (empty grid initially). Populate from InventoryManager containers. Show drag-drop zones. Support drag from player inventory ↔ character inventory. Validate bound items: refuse drops if item has `bound_to_character: true`. Emit/listen to `container_inventory_changed` signal to refresh display on external changes.
20. **Implement character stat tracking and persistence** — CharacterManager persists character stats to `user://characters/<char_id>.json` automatically on `modify_stat()` call. Games emit stat changes via `CharacterManager.modify_stat(char_id, stat, delta)`. Character Creator UI reads stats from CharacterManager when displaying character selection. Stats are per-character, global (not per-save).
21. **Add character export to JSON** — Implement "Export" button on character cards in Gallery tab. Clicking exports character definition (name, body_parts, stats, category, creation date) to `user://exports/character_<name>_<timestamp>.json` (readable JSON for sharing/backup). Show success notification with file path.
22. **Implement character save/load state** — In `character_creator.gd`, implement `save_state() -> Dictionary` returning `{ currently_viewing_character_id, active_tab, scroll_positions }`. Implement `load_state(data: Dictionary)` restoring session. Allows user to resume browsing/creation session.
23. **Integrate game query API** — Expose public static/singleton methods:
    * `CharacterManager.get_character(char_id) -> Dictionary` (full char data or empty dict if not found)
    * `CharacterManager.get_character_stats(char_id) -> Dictionary` (just stats dict)
    * `CharacterManager.modify_stat(char_id, stat_name, delta) -> bool`
    * `CharacterManager.get_all_characters() -> Array[Dictionary]` (all active characters)
    * `CharacterManager.get_character_inventory_count(char_id) -> int`
    * `InventoryManager.get_container_slots(char_id) -> Array` (character's inventory items)
    * Games import these to render/equip/progress characters.

### Additional Implementation Notes

* **Texture Resolution Flexibility** : 32×32 canonical sprites enforced in asset manifest. UI preview thumbnails (48×48) scale on render. Settings infrastructure prepared for future user-configurable scaling (deferred feature).
* **Name Uniqueness** : Character names validated globally across all saves and users (single persistent character database).
* **Stat Bounds MVP** : 1–99 fixed for MVP. Future progression module can raise caps per level or unlock additional stats.
* **Texture Caching Strategy** : BodyPartRegistry lazy-loads textures on Character Creator scene init, caches by part_id to avoid re-reads. Textures never hot-reloaded during session.
* **Graveyard Persistence** : Stores minimal epitaphs permanently. Export/import features deferred for future enhancement.

This plan is now  **complete and ready for implementation** .
